narration_fil: Nakinig si BHW Datu kay Elena. Nagtanong si Elena kung sino ang makakakita ng kanyang household form. Pumayag siyang mag-usap muli kasama ang midwife. Kailangang ibahagi ni Datu ang usapan nang hindi ikinukuwento sa buong barangay.
narration_en: BHW Datu listened to Elena. Elena asked who could see her household form. She agreed to talk again with the midwife. Datu needs to hand over the concern without telling the whole barangay.

display_en:
Report, not assumption.
Action and agreement.

narration_fil: Ihiwalay ang sinabi ng residente sa sariling hula. Iulat sa awtorisadong katrabaho ang kailangang impormasyon lamang. Isama ang ginawa, napagkasunduan at kailangan pang tulong. Pagkatapos, itanong sa sarili: Nakinig ba ako? Ano ang nakatulong? Ano ang isang babaguhin ko sa susunod?
narration_en: Separate the resident’s words from your assumptions. Share only necessary information with the authorized colleague. Include the action, agreement and support still needed. Then ask yourself: Did I listen? What helped? What one thing will I change next time?

check.feedback_fil: 1: Bansag ito sa tao at hindi malinaw na paglalarawan ng alalahanin. 2: Ito ang tanong na sinabi niya at mahalaga sa susunod na usapan. 3: Hula ito sa motibo ni Elena, hindi nakumpirmang impormasyon.
check.feedback_en: 1: This labels the person rather than describing the concern. 2: This is what she asked and is relevant to the next conversation. 3: This guesses Elena’s motive rather than reporting confirmed information.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag para sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read why each choice helps or does not help.

display_fil:
Tanong: sino ang makakakita ng form?
Hakbang: usapan kasama ang midwife.
Kailangan: kumpirmahin ang oras.
display_en:
Question: who can see the form?
Action: conversation with the midwife.
Needed: confirm the time.
narration_fil: Handover: “Nagtanong si Elena kung sino ang makakakita ng household form. Ipinaliwanag ko ang layunin ng pagbisita. Pumayag siyang makausap ang midwife bukas. Pakikumpirma ang oras.” Hindi kasama ang bansag na “mahirap kausap.” Ang pagninilay ni Datu: mas maagang mag-alok ng pribadong lugar.
narration_en: Handover: “Elena asked who can see the household form. I explained the visit’s purpose. She agreed to speak with the midwife tomorrow. Please confirm the time.” It does not label her “difficult.” Datu’s reflection: offer a private place earlier.

display_fil:
Awtorisadong paraan ng pag-uulat.
Kailangang detalye lamang.
Hindi tiyak: itanong sa supervisor.
Agarang panganib: emergency contact muna.
display_en:
Use the authorized reporting channel.
Share necessary details only.
Unsure: ask the supervisor.
Immediate danger: emergency contact first.
narration_fil: Gamitin ang awtorisadong paraan ng pag-uulat sa inyong lugar. Huwag ilagay ang personal na kuwento sa pampublikong chat. Humingi ng gabay sa midwife o supervisor kung hindi tiyak kung anong detalye ang kailangan. Kung may agarang panganib, unahin ang emergency contact at saka kumpletuhin ang kinakailangang ulat.
narration_en: Use the authorized reporting channel in your locality. Do not put personal stories in a public chat. Ask the midwife or supervisor if you are unsure which details are needed. If there is immediate danger, prioritize the emergency contact, then complete the necessary report.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tiyak itong pagbabago na maaari niyang subukan at suriin. 2: Hindi nito pinabubuti ang sariling pakikitungo o access sa serbisyo. 3: Hindi nito sinusuri ang aktuwal na nangyari o kailangang baguhin.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is a specific change he can try and review. 2: This does not improve his response or access to service. 3: This does not examine what happened or what needs to change.

narration_fil: Natanggap ng midwife ang maikling handover at kukumpirmahin ang oras. Isinulat ni Datu ang isang babaguhin sa susunod na usapan. Sa Lunes, ipasuri sa midwife ang blangkong handover checklist. Gumamit ng kathang-isip na kaso sa practice. Salita: handover — paglilipat ng mahalagang impormasyon sa susunod na tutulong.
narration_en: The midwife receives the short handover and will confirm the time. Datu identifies one change for the next conversation. On Monday, ask the midwife to review the blank handover checklist. Use a fictional case in practice. Word: handover — passing necessary information to the next person helping.
